brief: Essay on what writing tools can and cannot fix, aimed at writers tempted by AI assistance. Must engage: (1) the history of writers blaming instruments (typewriter panic, word-processor panic) and what actually changed; (2) the honest case that drafting machinery changes what gets written, not just how fast; (3) a position on where the writer's judgment is irreplaceable, argued not asserted. The piece must not mention any product by name and must not end with reassurance.
